blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag has challenged Vice President Sara Duterte to disclose what she is referring to as his “conflict of interest” regarding the bureau’s probe into the “cash delivery” allegations of dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. Duterte, in a press conference earlier Tuesday, first challenged Matibag to file a case against Gracioso and then said that there’s an alleged conflict of interest involving the NBI director. “Bago ko ilabas yung conflict of interest ni Matibag, gusto kong makita kung totoo ba talagang professional siya na NBI director na kasuhan niya si Gracioso. […]... Keep on reading: Matibag dares Sara Duterte to reveal alleged ‘conflict of interest’
